```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(crosstalk)
```

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Excel file
file_path <- "C:/MRM/docs/other/xlsx/LandUseStat.xlsx"

# Get all county sheet names
counties <- excel_sheets(file_path)

# Read all county sheets
data_all <- lapply(counties, function(cty) {
  
  df <- read_excel(
    file_path,
    sheet = cty
  )
  
  # SE Data categories
  section_names <- c(
    "Population and Households",
    "Employment",
    "Students"
  )
  
  # Identify category rows
  df$Category <- ifelse(
    df[[1]] %in% section_names,
    df[[1]],
    NA
  )
  
  # Fill category downward
  df <- fill(df, Category)
  
  # Add county name
  df$County <- cty
  
  df
  
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Add unique row ID
data_all$.row_id <- seq_len(nrow(data_all))
```

```{r format_data, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Make a copy for displaying in the tables
data_display <- data_all

# Identify numeric columns
num_cols <- sapply(
  data_display,
  is.numeric
)

# Format numeric columns:
# Whole number -> no decimals
# Decimal -> two decimals
data_display[num_cols] <- lapply(
  data_display[num_cols],
  function(x) {
    
    ifelse(
      is.na(x),
      NA,
      ifelse(
        x == floor(x),
        formatC(
          x,
          format = "f",
          digits = 0
        ),
        formatC(
          x,
          format = "f",
          digits = 2
        )
      )
    )
    
  }
)

# Create SharedData for county filtering
shared_data <- SharedData$new(
  data_display,
  key = ~.row_id,
  group = "landuse"
)
```

## Select County

```{r county_filter, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# County dropdown
# Only ONE county can be selected
filter_select(
  id = "county",
  label = " ",
  sharedData = shared_data,
  group = ~County,
  multiple = FALSE
)

```

# SE Data {.tabset}

## Population and Households

```{r population_table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Keep only Population and Households
population_data <- data_display %>%
  filter(
    Category == "Population and Households"
  )

# Create SharedData
# Same group as county filter
population_shared <- SharedData$new(
  population_data,
  key = ~.row_id,
  group = "landuse"
)

# Find columns to hide
hide_cols_population <- which(
  names(population_data) %in%
    c(
      "Category",
      "County",
      ".row_id"
    )
) - 1

# Population and Households table
htmltools::div(
  
  id = "population_table_container",
  
  datatable(
    population_shared,
    
    filter = "top",
    
    extensions = "Buttons",
    
    options = list(
      
      pageLength = 12,
      
      lengthMenu = c(
        5,
        10,
        20,
        50,
        100
      ),
      
      scrollX = TRUE,
      
      fixedHeader = TRUE,
      
      autoWidth = FALSE,
      
      dom = "Bfrtip",
      
      # CSV download button
      buttons = list(
        list(
          extend = "csv",
          text = "Download CSV",
          filename = "Population_Households"
        )
      ),
      
      columnDefs = list(
        
        # First column width
        list(
          width = "120px",
          targets = 0
        ),
        
        # All columns width
        list(
          width = "100px",
          targets = "_all"
        ),
        
        # Hide Category, County, and .row_id
        list(
          targets = hide_cols_population,
          visible = FALSE
        )
      )
    ),
    
    rownames = FALSE
  )
  
)
```

##Hide Tables Until County Is Selected

```{r hide_table, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
htmltools::tags$script(
  htmltools::HTML("
    
    function setupCountyTableVisibility() {
      
      // Find the county filter
      var countyDiv = document.getElementById('county');
      
      // Wait until Crosstalk/Selectize has created the control
      if (
        !countyDiv ||
        !countyDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized').length
      ) {
        
        setTimeout(setupCountyTableVisibility, 100);
        return;
      }
      
      var countySelect =
        countyDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized')[0].selectize;

      // Remove All option
      countySelect.removeOption('');
      // Get the Selectize object
     // var countySelect =
        //countyDiv.getElementsByClassName('selectized')[0].selectize;
      
      // Find the three table containers
      var populationTable =
        document.getElementById('population_table_container');
      
      var employmentTable =
        document.getElementById('employment_table_container');
      
      var studentsTable =
        document.getElementById('students_table_container');
      
      
      // Function to check county selection
      function checkCountySelection() {
        
        var county = countySelect.getValue();
        
        // ---------------------------------------------
        // County selected
        // ---------------------------------------------
        
        if (county) {
          
          if (populationTable) {
            populationTable.style.display = '';
          }
          
          if (employmentTable) {
            employmentTable.style.display = '';
          }
          
          if (studentsTable) {
            studentsTable.style.display = '';
          }
          
        }
        
        // ---------------------------------------------
        // No county selected
        // ---------------------------------------------
        
        else {
          
          if (populationTable) {
            populationTable.style.display = 'none';
          }
          
          if (employmentTable) {
            employmentTable.style.display = 'none';
          }
          
          if (studentsTable) {
            studentsTable.style.display = 'none';
          }
          
        }
      }
      
      
      // Check whenever county changes
      countySelect.on(
        'change',
        checkCountySelection
      );
      
      
      // Hide tables when page first loads
      checkCountySelection();
      
    }
    
    
    // Start after the page has loaded
    $(document).ready(
      function() {
        setupCountyTableVisibility();
      }
    );
    
  ")
)
```
